name: DCASE 2016 Task 2: Sound Event Detection in Synthetic Audio
description: DCASE 2016 Task 2 is a sound event detection dataset consisting of 72 synthesized audio mixtures (18 development, 54 evaluation) generated by mixing 220 isolated sound events across 11 sound classes into continuous office room background noise.

publisher.name: DCASE Community & Queen Mary University of London

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.notes: Distributed on Zenodo under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International.

source_references.title: Sound Event Detection in Synthetic Audio: Analysis of the DCASE 2016 Task Results

verification.notes: Verified against WASPAA 2017 paper (DOI: 10.1109/WASPAA.2017.8169985) and DCASE 2016 official records. Comprises 72 synthesized audio mixture tracks (18 development, 54 evaluation) generated from 220 isolated sound events across 11 classes.

size.notes: 16-bit 44.1 kHz WAV audio and text event annotations.

citation.paper_title: Sound Event Detection in Synthetic Audio: Analysis of the DCASE 2016 Task Results
